mapper.select: select coalesce(sum(case when status in (2, 3, 4) then pay_amount else 0 end), 0) as sale_amount, coalesce(sum(case when status in (2, 3, 4) then 1 else 0 end), 0) as order_count, coalesce(sum(case when status in (2, 3, 4) and member_id > 0 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as member_order_count, coalesce(sum(case when status in (2, 3, 4) then discount_total else 0 end), 0) as discount_total, coalesce(sum(case when status = 7 then pay_amount else 0 end), 0) as refund_amount from biz_order where store_id = 1 and create_time >= #{day} and create_time < date_add(#{day}, interval 1 day)

select coalesce(sum(oi.share_amount - oi.cost_price * oi.qty), 0) as gross_profit from biz_order_item oi join biz_order o on o.order_id = oi.order_id where o.store_id = 1 and o.status in (2, 3, 4) and o.create_time >= #{day} and o.create_time < date_add(#{day}, interval 1 day)

select coalesce(sum(case when o.status in (2, 3, 4) then o.pay_amount else 0 end), 0) as saleAmount, coalesce(sum(case when o.status in (2, 3, 4) then 1 else 0 end), 0) as orderCount, coalesce(sum(case when o.status in (2, 3, 4) and o.member_id > 0 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as memberOrderCount, coalesce(sum(case when o.status in (2, 3, 4) then o.discount_total else 0 end), 0) as discountTotal, coalesce(sum(case when o.status = 7 then o.pay_amount else 0 end), 0) as refundAmount, coalesce(( select sum(oi.share_amount - oi.cost_price * oi.qty) from biz_order_item oi where oi.order_id in ( select o2.order_id from biz_order o2 where o2.store_id = 1 and o2.status in (2, 3, 4) and o2.create_time >= #{start} and o2.create_time < date_add(#{end}, interval 1 day) ) ), 0) as grossProfit from biz_order o where o.store_id = 1 and o.create_time >= #{start} and o.create_time < date_add(#{end}, interval 1 day)

choose.when: select cast(coalesce(c.category_id, 0) as char) as dimensionKey, coalesce(c.category_name, '未分类') as dimensionName, coalesce(sum(oi.share_amount), 0) as saleAmount, count(distinct o.order_id) as orderCount, coalesce(sum(oi.share_amount - oi.cost_price * oi.qty), 0) as grossProfit from biz_order o join biz_order_item oi on oi.order_id = o.order_id left join biz_book b on b.book_id = oi.book_id left join biz_category c on c.category_id = b.category_id where o.store_id = 1 and o.status in (2, 3, 4) and o.create_time >= #{start} and o.create_time < date_add(#{end}, interval 1 day) group by c.category_id, c.category_name order by saleAmount desc

select cast(o.member_level_id as char) as dimensionKey, coalesce(ml.level_name, '散客/未知') as dimensionName, coalesce(sum(o.pay_amount), 0) as saleAmount, count(distinct o.order_id) as orderCount, coalesce(sum(( select sum(oi.share_amount - oi.cost_price * oi.qty) from biz_order_item oi where oi.order_id = o.order_id )), 0) as grossProfit from biz_order o left join biz_member_level ml on ml.level_id = o.member_level_id where o.store_id = 1 and o.status in (2, 3, 4) and o.create_time >= #{start} and o.create_time < date_add(#{end}, interval 1 day) group by o.member_level_id, ml.level_name order by saleAmount desc

select cast(o.order_type as char) as dimensionKey, case o.order_type when 1 then '门店收银' when 2 then '线上下单' else '教材预订' end as dimensionName, coalesce(sum(o.pay_amount), 0) as saleAmount, count(distinct o.order_id) as orderCount, coalesce(sum(( select sum(oi.share_amount - oi.cost_price * oi.qty) from biz_order_item oi where oi.order_id = o.order_id )), 0) as grossProfit from biz_order o where o.store_id = 1 and o.status in (2, 3, 4) and o.create_time >= #{start} and o.create_time < date_add(#{end}, interval 1 day) group by o.order_type order by saleAmount desc

select o.cashier_by as dimensionKey, case when o.cashier_by = '' then '未记录' else o.cashier_by end as dimensionName, coalesce(sum(o.pay_amount), 0) as saleAmount, count(distinct o.order_id) as orderCount, coalesce(sum(( select sum(oi.share_amount - oi.cost_price * oi.qty) from biz_order_item oi where oi.order_id = o.order_id )), 0) as grossProfit from biz_order o where o.store_id = 1 and o.status in (2, 3, 4) and o.create_time >= #{start} and o.create_time < date_add(#{end}, interval 1 day) group by o.cashier_by order by saleAmount desc
choose.otherwise: select '' as dimensionKey, '' as dimensionName, 0 as saleAmount, 0 as orderCount, 0 as grossProfit from dual where 1 = 0

mapper.select: select b.book_id as bookId, b.isbn as isbn, b.title as title, coalesce(sum(s.qty_available + s.qty_locked + s.qty_damaged), 0) as stockQty, (select max(sf.create_time) from biz_stock_flow sf where sf.book_id = b.book_id and sf.biz_type = 2) as lastSaleTime from biz_book b left join biz_stock s on s.book_id = b.book_id and s.store_id = b.store_id where b.store_id = 1 and b.del_flag = '0' and b.status <> 4 group by b.book_id, b.isbn, b.title having stockQty > 0 and (lastSaleTime is null or lastSaleTime < #{threshold}) order by lastSaleTime asc, stockQty desc limit #{limit}

select coalesce(c.category_name, '未分类') as categoryName, coalesce(sum(oi.share_amount), 0) as saleAmount from biz_order o join biz_order_item oi on oi.order_id = o.order_id left join biz_book b on b.book_id = oi.book_id left join biz_category c on c.category_id = b.category_id where o.store_id = 1 and o.status in (2, 3, 4) and o.create_time >= #{start} and o.create_time < date_add(#{end}, interval 1 day) group by c.category_name order by saleAmount desc

select date(create_time) as date, count(*) as count from biz_member where store_id = 1 and create_time >= #{start} and create_time < date_add(#{end}, interval 1 day) group by date(create_time) order by date
select case when level_name = '' then '未分级' else level_name end as levelName, count(*) as count from biz_member where store_id = 1 group by level_name order by count desc

select count(distinct member_id) as activeMembers, count(*) as memberOrders, coalesce(sum(pay_amount), 0) as memberSaleAmount from biz_order where store_id = 1 and status in (2, 3, 4) and member_id > 0 and create_time >= #{start} and create_time < date_add(#{end}, interval 1 day)

select coalesce(sum(case when status in (2, 3, 4) then pay_amount else 0 end), 0) as totalSale, coalesce(sum(case when status in (2, 3, 4) and member_id > 0 then pay_amount else 0 end), 0) as memberSale from biz_order where store_id = 1 and create_time >= #{start} and create_time < date_add(#{end}, interval 1 day)

select date_format(date_sub(t.first_order, interval weekday(t.first_order) day), '%Y-%m-%d') as cohort, count(*) as cohortSize, sum(case when exists ( select 1 from biz_order o2 where o2.member_id = t.member_id and o2.status in (2, 3, 4) and o2.create_time >= date_add(t.first_order, interval 1 day) and o2.create_time < date_add(t.first_order, interval 8 day) ) then 1 else 0 end) as retained from ( select member_id, min(create_time) as first_order from biz_order where store_id = 1 and status in (2, 3, 4) group by member_id ) t where t.first_order >= #{start} and t.first_order < date_add(#{end}, interval 1 day) group by cohort order by cohort

select date_format(t.first_order, '%Y-%m') as cohort, count(*) as cohortSize, sum(case when exists ( select 1 from biz_order o2 where o2.member_id = t.member_id and o2.status in (2, 3, 4) and o2.create_time >= date_add(t.first_order, interval 1 day) and o2.create_time < date_add(t.first_order, interval 31 day) ) then 1 else 0 end) as retained from ( select member_id, min(create_time) as first_order from biz_order where store_id = 1 and status in (2, 3, 4) group by member_id ) t where t.first_order >= #{start} and t.first_order < date_add(#{end}, interval 1 day) group by cohort order by cohort

select coalesce(sum(s.qty_available), 0) as available, coalesce(sum(s.qty_locked), 0) as locked, coalesce(sum(s.qty_borrowed), 0) as borrowed, coalesce(sum(s.qty_damaged), 0) as damaged from biz_stock s join biz_book b on b.book_id = s.book_id where s.store_id = 1 and b.category_id = #{categoryId}

select coalesce(sum(oi.qty), 0) as soldQty, count(distinct oi.book_id) as soldKinds from biz_order o join biz_order_item oi on oi.order_id = o.order_id join biz_book b on b.book_id = oi.book_id where o.store_id = 1 and o.status in (2, 3, 4) and oi.book_id > 0 and o.create_time >= #{start} and o.create_time < date_add(#{end}, interval 1 day) and b.category_id = #{categoryId}

select count(distinct s.book_id) as stockKinds from biz_stock s join biz_book b on b.book_id = s.book_id where s.store_id = 1 and (s.qty_available + s.qty_locked + s.qty_damaged) > 0 and b.category_id = #{categoryId}

select b.book_id as bookId, b.isbn, b.title, coalesce(sum(s.qty_available), 0) as qtyAvailable from biz_book b left join biz_stock s on s.book_id = b.book_id and s.store_id = b.store_id where b.store_id = 1 and b.del_flag = '0' and b.status in (1, 3) and b.category_id = #{categoryId} group by b.book_id, b.isbn, b.title having qtyAvailable = 0 order by b.book_id limit 50

select coalesce(sum((s.qty_available + s.qty_locked + s.qty_damaged) * b.cost_price), 0) as totalAmount from biz_stock s join biz_book b on b.book_id = s.book_id where s.store_id = 1 and b.category_id = #{categoryId}

select count(*) as listCount, coalesce(sum(reserve_qty), 0) as reserveQty, coalesce(sum(arrived_qty), 0) as arrivedQty, coalesce(sum(picked_qty), 0) as pickedQty from biz_textbook_list where store_id = 1
and list_id = #{listId} and term = #{term}

choose.when: select i.list_id as listId, i.book_id as bookId, i.isbn, i.title, i.reserve_qty as reserveQty, i.arrived_qty as arrivedQty, i.picked_qty as pickedQty, i.remain_qty as remainQty from biz_textbook_list_item i join biz_textbook_list l on l.list_id = i.list_id where l.store_id = 1 and l.list_id = #{listId} order by i.item_id
choose.otherwise: select i.isbn, max(i.title) as title, coalesce(sum(i.reserve_qty), 0) as reserveQty, coalesce(sum(i.arrived_qty), 0) as arrivedQty, coalesce(sum(i.picked_qty), 0) as pickedQty, coalesce(sum(i.remain_qty), 0) as remainQty from biz_textbook_list_item i join biz_textbook_list l on l.list_id = i.list_id where l.store_id = 1 and l.term = #{term} group by i.isbn order by i.isbn

mapper.select: select date(create_time) as metric_date, coalesce(sum(case when status in (2, 3, 4) then pay_amount else 0 end), 0) as sale_amount, coalesce(sum(case when status in (2, 3, 4) then 1 else 0 end), 0) as order_count, coalesce(sum(case when status in (2, 3, 4) and member_id > 0 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as member_order_count, coalesce(sum(case when status in (2, 3, 4) then discount_total else 0 end), 0) as discount_total, coalesce(sum(case when status = 7 then pay_amount else 0 end), 0) as refund_amount from biz_order where store_id = 1 and create_time >= #{start} and create_time < date_add(#{end}, interval 1 day) group by date(create_time) order by metric_date

select date(o.create_time) as metric_date, coalesce(sum(oi.share_amount - oi.cost_price * oi.qty), 0) as gross_profit from biz_order_item oi join biz_order o on o.order_id = oi.order_id where o.store_id = 1 and o.status in (2, 3, 4) and o.create_time >= #{start} and o.create_time < date_add(#{end}, interval 1 day) group by date(o.create_time) order by metric_date
select metric_date, metric_code, metric_value from biz_metric_daily where store_id = 1 and dim_type = '' and dim_value = '' and metric_date >= #{start} and metric_date <= #{end}

select oi.book_id as bookId, oi.isbn as isbn, oi.title as title, coalesce(sum(oi.qty), 0) as saleQty, coalesce(sum(oi.share_amount), 0) as saleAmount from biz_order_item oi join biz_order o on o.order_id = oi.order_id where o.store_id = 1 and o.status in (2, 3, 4) and oi.book_id > 0 and o.create_time >= #{day} and o.create_time < date_add(#{day}, interval 1 day) group by oi.book_id, oi.isbn, oi.title order by saleQty desc, saleAmount desc limit #{limit}

select coalesce(c.category_name, '未分类') as categoryName, coalesce(sum(oi.share_amount), 0) as saleAmount from biz_order_item oi join biz_order o on o.order_id = oi.order_id left join biz_book b on b.book_id = oi.book_id left join biz_category c on c.category_id = b.category_id where o.store_id = 1 and o.status in (2, 3, 4) and o.create_time >= #{day} and o.create_time < date_add(#{day}, interval 1 day) group by c.category_name order by saleAmount desc

select (select count(*) from biz_member where store_id = 1 and create_time >= #{day} and create_time < date_add(#{day}, interval 1 day)) as newMembers, (select count(distinct member_id) from biz_order where store_id = 1 and status in (2, 3, 4) and member_id > 0 and create_time >= #{day} and create_time < date_add(#{day}, interval 1 day)) as activeMembers
